csv_project_name: CM/GC for Chaboya Yard Zero Emission Bus Infrastructure
csv_scope_of_work: The Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority (VTA) intends to procure the Chaboya Yard Zero-Emission Bus (ZEB) Charging Infrastructure Project using the Construction Manager/General Contractor (CMGC) project delivery method. Under this approach, VTA will select a qualified, California-licensed General Contractor to work collaboratively with VTA s retained design consultant ( Designer ) and provide pre-construction services during the development of the Plans, Specifications, and Estimate (PS&E). Following completion of the pre-construction phase, and subject to the terms and conditions of the procurement and satisfaction of all applicable requirements, the selected contractor will have the opportunity, if successful, to perform the construction phase of the Project.
